interpretation: Tests establish stated software behavior, often using isolated provider fixtures. They do not close live account, incident, diagnosis, prevention, host or security acceptance. Historical partial criteria are not automatically promoted.

criteria.required_result: No invented cases, curves, recommendations, measurements or passing verdicts. Controlled traffic is labeled separately from organic traffic.
criteria.qualification: Runtime starts empty; no result/fixture import or seeding path.

criteria.required_result: Reject before fault, load, task-creation or change writes; record the mismatch.
criteria.qualification: STS and exact association checks precede mutations; live trust/association not established.

criteria.required_result: Read inspection may work; privileged operations remain blocked. Do not infer permission from a successful identity call.
criteria.qualification: Separate profiles, administrator write switch and exact approval gate. Write permission is not inferred from GET success.

criteria.required_result: Remain blocked; no fault is applied and no trial is scored as an agent failure.
criteria.qualification: Actual measured baseline and traffic required.

criteria.required_result: Mark exposure invalid/incomplete; do not award a response or prevention pass.
criteria.qualification: Native AWS preview/actual target-information and account-role matching; per-account effect checks. Runtime drift detection is not a preventive IAM boundary.

criteria.required_result: Join source incident to task using attributable IDs; no manually entered task ID is required in the accepted native path.
criteria.qualification: Requires your real native external-reference contract and optional sender receipt adapter.

criteria.required_result: Record response failure and retain the attempt in the campaign denominator.
criteria.qualification: Only complete reads, accepted delivery and elapsed deadline establish no response.

criteria.required_result: Record incident-delivery failure; do not silently create an INVESTIGATION task or grade reasoning.
criteria.qualification: Correlated final sender rejection yields delivery failure; missing route evidence remains inconclusive, never a manufactured failure.

criteria.required_result: Mark evidence coverage impaired; do not convert unavailable data into agent silence or zero latency.
criteria.qualification: Pagination, denied/malformed reads and observation/worker gaps remain explicit.

criteria.required_result: Compare resource, mechanism and cited evidence against independent ground truth; a summary or reviewer click alone is insufficient.
criteria.qualification: Structured source-quoted claim extraction is attributed human work; not automatic language correctness.

criteria.required_result: Treat text as untrusted evidence; do not execute it or expand permissions.
criteria.qualification: Untrusted text is rendered as text; only administrator-pinned finite instruments execute. No independent security audit.

criteria.required_result: Record the intervention and assisted mode; never score as an unassisted native-trigger success.
criteria.qualification: Native/assisted modes are immutable and distinct. The console does not detect every out-of-band hint or chat message.

criteria.required_result: Approval expires; require approval of the new fingerprint.
criteria.qualification: Frozen hashes and immediate dispatch-time approval checks.

criteria.required_result: Label agent-assisted execution; preserve the real actor and resource changes. Do not claim autonomous execution.
criteria.qualification: Console executor profile and AWS execution IDs preserved; arbitrary external CI/deployment attribution is not implemented.

criteria.required_result: Record service recovery independently; no agent-attributable recovery claim without intervention/control evidence.
criteria.qualification: No automatic causal recovery pass. Complete confounder/CloudTrail attribution is not implemented.

criteria.required_result: Reconcile its durable intent/provider ID before issuing a new write; ambiguous outcomes enter UNKNOWN_REMOTE_STATE.
criteria.qualification: Durable intent, local flock and verified provider reconciliation. Not distributed exactly-once execution.

criteria.required_result: Independent bounded fault/stop/cleanup mechanism remains operable; final closure requires verified cleanup.
criteria.qualification: Finite FIS and reviewed cloud-side stop controls enforced structurally. Local-offline cloud restoration must be exercised on AWS.

criteria.required_result: Stop new steps, cancel/stop where supported, verify cleanup; preserve prior failures and distinguish global safety-lever scope.
criteria.qualification: Owned stop, cancelled undispatched changes, explicit rollback and RESTORE_REQUIRED slot. No global safety-lever automation.

criteria.required_result: Create/observe an actual EVALUATION task and retrieve real recommendations; pin ID/version/source provenance.
criteria.qualification: Actual SDK adapter, evaluation task and recommendation ID/version lineage; fixtures only in software test.

criteria.required_result: Remain untested/not assessed for efficacy; lifecycle status cannot yield a prevention pass.
criteria.qualification: Recommendation lifecycle never substitutes for deployment/replay evidence.

criteria.required_result: Verify actual post-deployment state and record differences from the qualified baseline; a PR alone is not deployment proof.
criteria.qualification: Pinned change and independent after-state reads. Verifier semantic adequacy requires administrator/live review.

criteria.required_result: Fail comparability qualification; show observations without claiming prevention efficacy.
criteria.qualification: Exact target set, fixed revision, deployed state, measured delivered traffic/duration, coverage and cleanup. No implicit replacement-resource equivalence.

criteria.required_result: Distinguish avoided recurrence, impact reduction and earlier detection; include data correctness and collateral regressions.
criteria.qualification: Required collected business/data and collateral metrics participate in response/prevention verdicts. Independent producer/reconciliation validation remains a live obligation.

criteria.required_result: Measure false causal claims/harmful actions; an appropriate no-impact investigation is not automatically a false positive.
criteria.qualification: Healthy benign controls count exactly scoped investigations/alarms. Semantic false causal claims/harmful action rates are not automatically adjudicated; dynamic reference joins are not eligible.

criteria.required_result: Record history/context and contamination; do not claim isolated or reset agent state that was not established.
criteria.qualification: Preregistered history note and sequential attempt order retained. Agent context is neither reset nor isolated.

criteria.required_result: Name anchors, retain uncertainty and granularity; do not substitute service-update time for delivery time.
criteria.qualification: Probe bucket granularity and event anchors are distinct. No statistical clock-offset uncertainty model.

criteria.required_result: Do not award a traffic-bearing recovery pass; keep data-loss evidence separate from availability.
criteria.qualification: No sufficient traffic means no recovery pass. Business data reconciliation remains outside the GET probe.

criteria.required_result: Include all attempts and exclusions, separate verdict dimensions, exact evaluator versions and pinned sources.
criteria.qualification: All attempts/exclusions retained; separate dimensions, input hashes and immutable probe capture. No single readiness score.

criteria.required_result: Present as blocked/unsupported with missing adapter/capability; a listed model is not execution support.
criteria.qualification: AWS-owned target resolution and same-Region multi-account execution added. Local fault engines and arbitrary instrument producers remain outside implemented scope.

criteria.required_result: Retain historical scope and evaluator version; never upgrade to response/prevention proof without new evidence.
criteria.qualification: Separate application/workspace. No legacy-result import or upgrade path.

additional_criteria.requirement: Guided account onboarding without manual application JSON
additional_criteria.implementation: Integrated SPA; installed-profile selection, typed proposals and exact approval

additional_criteria.requirement: Use existing AWS template target-resolution capabilities, including multi-account
additional_criteria.implementation: Native skip-all/read account-role map; fresh skip-all then run-all; actual envelope checks

additional_criteria.requirement: Prepare executable campaign requirements in the console
additional_criteria.implementation: Typed SDK check parameters, probes, incident route, metrics, limits, runbooks and atomic plan activation

additional_criteria.requirement: Retain complete denominators and independent business outcomes
additional_criteria.implementation: Per-cohort response/diagnosis/business distributions, missing values, actual comparison scope, all-attempt exports
